substantive_findings: 2306.03008 Table 1 counts active B n(n-1)/2 and active W n^2; Eq. (5) gives B flavor antisymmetry.
Its Table 2 keeps W as an unrestricted ordered-flavor monomial.
hep-ph/0606248 Eq. (10) defines W flavor projections with 1/2; only the antisymmetric part enters its tree-level neutrino magnetic interaction.
1612.04527 Eq. (25) and 2105.09329 Eqs. (4.78), (4.81), (4.83)-(4.85) identify target retained-sterile spectator-current field classes.
coefficient_conversion_limitations: Hermitian conjugation, scalar epsilon conversion and spinor/flavor order must be fixed.
2306.03008 uses all-Dminus and Pauli insertion, whereas this packet uses all-Dplus and T=tau/2.
Bell includes explicit gauge couplings and uses epsilon=-i tau2, with a stated negative nonlinear weak curvature term.
Four-fermion vector-current to scalar-Fierz maps and repeated-lepton flavor identities require explicit conversion.
Neither these counts nor the selected current-class correspondence closes the full dimension-seven EFT.
